models.title: Gain or loss on sale of a long-lived asset
models.summary: The gain or loss on an asset sale is the proceeds less its carrying amount.

relationship.original_equation: Gain or loss = sales proceeds - carrying amount at sale
relationship.locator: Investing Activities Leading to an Increase in Cash
relationship.translation_notes: Positive output is a gain and negative output is a loss.

Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: Proceeds and carrying amount refer to the same asset, transaction date and currency.
The proceeds measure is consistent with the specified treatment of transaction costs.
limitations: A gain or loss is not the same as total cash received.
Taxes, noncash consideration and transaction costs may require separate accounting.

models.title: Fair value less costs of disposal
models.summary: Fair value less costs of disposal subtracts estimated disposal costs from fair value.

relationship.original_equation: Fair value less costs of disposal = fair value - disposal costs
relationship.locator: About: fair value less costs to sell
relationship.translation_notes: The calculation preserves the source-defined net-of-disposal-cost measure.

assumptions: Fair value and disposal costs refer to the same asset or cash-generating unit, date and currency.
limitations: This quantity is one input to recoverable amount; the higher-of test is not implemented here.
Actual proceeds and fair value are different quantities.
